page.overview:
What is Michel Delving?

Michel Delving was the chief settlement and largest town of the Shire, located on the edge of the Westfarthing.

It lay within the White Downs along the Great East Road, and was south of its smaller counterpart, the village of Little Delving. It was unofficially considered by Hobbits to be the "capital" of the Shire, generally filling that role. Although it was amongst a hilly region, the town didn't just have Hobbit-holes, as it also had numerous above-ground houses made of brick, wood or stone.

The Mayor of the Shire, the only real official of the entire country, held his office in Michel Delving, and was elected here every seven years at the Free Fair. The Mayor went on to fill the positions of Postmaster and First Shirriff.

Famous buildings located within Michel Delving included the Mayor's residence of the Town Hole, the storage tunnels that became the Lockholes, and the museum called the Mathom-house.
